coverage_assessment: Bounded March first-pass discovery is ready for review, not a finding of event absence or exhaustive coverage. Captured query rows cover English, Dari, Pashto and Arabic terms; early, middle and late March boundaries; Kabul, Herat, Kandahar, Jalalabad, Mazar, Nangarhar and Kunar; women, labor, teachers, education, UN/UNAMA and human-rights reporting. Search display yielded an unverified March 8 Kabul women’s protest lead and an official UNAMA quarter-report archive listing; neither is body-verified or used to change the existing candidate. The one opened Afghanistan International report supports the existing March 7 Kabul candidate, but has no numerical turnout; eligibility remains pending_threshold and G003 remains open. Native search headers/results and some historical action timestamps remain unavailable. Official baseline pending.
